During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code to exploit a vulnerability in an internet-facing server at the Mexico Federal Tax Authority to achieve remote command execution.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach) 

During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code with planting a webshell on the victims public-facing portal.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
